data.raw_text: 🚨LANDFALL: Titanic Typhoon Fung-wong (UwanPH) has collided into the Philippines shortly after reaching a CATEGORY 4 peak intensity, with her enormous eye moving onshore in the Baler Bay Area of Aurora. Violent waves and significant storm surge flooding are being reported near the landfall location as the powerful, eastern half of Fung-wong’s eyewall is now moments away from roaring into Luzon. This is very close to where Typhoon Man-yi (Pepito) made landfall in November of last year.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY 

In view of the Delhi Jal Board drainage maintenance & upgradation work at New Rohtak Road (from Kamal T-Point to Zakhira Flyover towards Punjabi Bagh), traffic movement will remain affected for 45 days starting 09.11.2025, between 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

📍 TRAFFIC RESTRICTIONS & IMPACT:
•Two lanes on New Rohtak Road (Anand Parbat stretch) will remain closed due to ongoing DJB work.
•Heavy & slow-moving traffic expected during working hours.

📍 ALTERNATIVE ROUTE:
•Commuters travelling towards Punjabi Bagh/West Delhi via New Rohtak Road are advised to take a right turn from Kamal T-Point towards Sarai Rohilla via Veer Banda Bairagi Marg & then proceed via Inderlok to reach their destination.

📍 ADVISORY TO COMMUTERS:
•Plan your journey in advance to avoid delays.
•Follow traffic signage & the directions of traffic police personnel at the site.
•Avoid the affected stretch of New Rohtak Road during work hours & use alternate routes wherever possible.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
